A mixed salad-style meal with grilled chicken pieces, rice, broccoli, leafy greens, green beans, and a few apparent chickpeas.

### 2 — Vessel

**Area = 3.14 × 13² ≈ 530 cm².**

### 3 — Items

### 8 — Sanity check
